release_body.value:
You can help ensure that children and youth continue to experience the joy, confidence, and curiosity that come from making and encountering art at the Gordon Smith Gallery and through Artists for Kids.

Through exhibitions, school programs, family art-making days, camps, bursaries, and scholarships, the Gordon and Marion Smith Foundation for Young Artists helps keep art education for life at the heart of our community.

The impact of your gift

Your donation supports programs that:

  • Welcome children and families into the Gallery
    Free and low-cost programs like Explore + Create Saturdays invite kids, parents, and grandparents to make art side by side, inspired by the current exhibition.
  • Support art education in schools
    Class visits and teacher resources connect K–12 students with original Canadian artworks and exhibitions at the Gordon Smith Gallery. Students learn to look closely, think critically, and express their ideas visually. They build skills they carry into every part of their lives.
  • Open doors to camps and deeper learning
    Bursaries and program support help young people attend after-school courses, Spring and Summer art camps, and the Paradise Valley Summer School of Visual Art, where they learn from professional artists and BC-certified art specialist teachers.
  • Invest in emerging young artists
    Scholarships for graduating students pursuing visual arts at the post-secondary level help the next generation of artists take their first steps with confidence.

Ways to Support

Every contribution makes a difference:

  • Make a one-time gift
    Choose an amount that is meaningful to you. For example:
    • $75 can provide art materials for a family Explore + Create session.
    • $150 can help bring a classroom to the Gallery for a guided visit.
    • $500 can support bursaries so that a young artist can attend camp.
  • Become a monthly donor
    A monthly gift—of any size—provides steady, reliable support for programs throughout the year.
  • Give in honour or in memory
    Celebrate a teacher, artist, or loved one with a tribute gift. We will gladly send a note acknowledging your gift.
  • Donate securities or explore legacy giving
    We gratefully accept gifts of securities and are happy to speak with you about including the Smith Foundation in your estate plans.

All donations over $25 are eligible for a charitable tax receipt in accordance with CRA regulations. Any donation of $1,000 or above will be recognized in the Gordon and Marion Smith Foundation and Artists for Kids’ Annual Report, including the donor page of each website.
